set.body:
Layer platform integration over the shared motion API.

Contracts: shared motion never depends on file IO, plotting, process execution, or JVM-only libraries; JVM adapters preserve affine, voxel size, TR, and sidecar-derived slice timing; CLI/reporting call the same typed MotionPlan/MotionEstimate surfaces.

Deliverables: NIfTI read/write adapters, BIDS/fMRIPrep scan discovery, estimate/apply/run/report CLI commands, TSV/CSV/report-bundle writers, and report data tests against volregger R/cli.R, R/cli_io.R, and R/reporting.R semantics where intentionally preserved.

Acceptance: JVM adapter tests cover metadata roundtrip, bad input diagnostics, and report bundle shape; shared JS tests are unaffected; command surfaces do not leak R list/S3 conventions.
set.title: Add motion JVM IO, BIDS, CLI, and report adapters
